dict.string: Dylan shows a countdown and a Join button before your meetings.
Dylan controls Spotify and Apple Music from the notch.
Dylan shows today's reminders and lets you check them off from the notch.
Dylan shows a camera mirror before meetings and, if you enroll, uses the built-in camera for Face Unlock. No images are stored.
Dylan uses your location for prayer times and to tell you when to leave for meetings at a physical place (both off by default).

Dylan records your voice with a screen recording, only when you turn on the microphone for it.
Dylan reads the sound of your music app for a live equalizer, and of the apps you turn down for volume per app. Nothing is recorded.
Dylan shows AirPods and other Bluetooth devices when they connect.
